headline: Sánchez, Feijóo and Abascal: three protagonists of the Spanish elections
summary: Pedro Sánchez, the conservative Alberto Núñez Feijóo and the far-right Santiago Abascal are the main contenders seeking to become Spain's prime minister.
why: Spain is the euro area's fourth-largest economy, and the outcome of its elections can influence fiscal policy, regulation and Spanish government bond markets.
original_headline: Sánchez, Feijóo y Abascal: tres protagonistas de las elecciones españolas
